text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ooooh, the swirling spirit of the Kamuy has protected me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"And with that, the Sapporo Kinen is put to rest!
Now then, shall we do a bit of sightseeing?"

While walking near the famous Sapporo Clock Tower
with Matikanefukukitaru...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, look, Trainer.
At the hands of that clock tower.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The compass is pointing directly south.
Could it be some kind of sign?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The racecourse in that direction is right around...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about my next race...
I want to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
For the last Takarazuka Kinen, I was allowed to run thanks to
the mercy of my cult-like fans. But...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I want to earn the votes with my own strength
and qualify fair and square!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Bundling countless hopes and wishes together,
here at Nakayama at the year's end.
choice_data_list: …Okay, let's go for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume who run well in the Sapporo Kinen
also do great in the Arima Kinen. Let's follow in their footsteps!"
